Retail Technology · Product and innovation

Proposed product concept · integrations unconfirmed

TRIXX SmartTrolley · ScanFlow

A smart-retail concept connecting an equipped trolley or shopper’s phone with a store catalogue and shopping workflow.

Enquire about TRIXX SmartTrolley · ScanFlow →

The need

Why this idea matters.

Shoppers and retailers need convenient ways to review a basket and its running total while ensuring store systems remain in control of prices and checkout.

Who it is for

Designed for a conversation with

Supermarkets, mini-markets, retailers and shopping-centre operators.

How it could work

A clear path from interest to review.

  1. 01

    Connect to a retailer’s configured product catalogue.

  2. 02

    Scan eligible items and review a running basket.

  3. 03

    Hand off to the retailer’s verified checkout and payment process.

Proposed features

What the concept explores.

  • Android touchscreen concept for equipped trolleys
  • Phone-based product scanning option
  • Barcode lookup and product information
  • Shopping lists, basket review and running total
  • Potential catalogue, loyalty and checkout integrations

Potential benefits

What it could make easier.

  • Makes basket information easier to review while shopping
  • Offers a phone-based route alongside dedicated trolley screens
  • Lets retailers decide which checkout, payment and stock controls apply

Specifications & safeguards

Details remain subject to review.

Pricing, dimensions, technical specifications, availability and timelines are not confirmed. Device compatibility, integrations, data handling, security and professional requirements must be reviewed for the specific project before any capability is promised.
